note: The queries both sides of the RAG bake-off run, written down so the two harnesses provably use identical strings. Owned jointly; atlas-side.js imports SANITY from its own copy and the two must stay equal.

universe.plotted: the 1541 films with plot text — the only films the dense side can index. Compare on this one.
universe.blindSpot: 663 films (30.1%) have no plot text and can never be returned by dense retrieval over plots

sanity.q: a paranoid film about surveillance and control
sanity.probes: a query whose core noun ('surveillance', 'control') is OUTSIDE the 59-attribute vocabulary. Atlas reads 26% of it. Dense retrieval over plot text should win here if it ever wins.

sanity.q: a slow quiet film about a friendship that quietly ends
sanity.probes: THE DISCRIMINATING TEST. Fingerprint-distance ranking put Ex Machina 2.8 from Banshees of Inisherin and buried Old Joy at #1291/2197. Does a MiniLM plot embedding repeat that failure? Reference points: old joy, the banshees of inisherin, ex machina.

sanity.q: a revenge film that isn't violent
sanity.probes: negation. A closed vocabulary can represent it; a cosine over one blended vector structurally cannot. Watch for Salo / Straw Dogs / Saving Private Ryan surfacing on the dense side.
